name: electron v44.3.0
body:
# Release Notes for v44.3.0

## Features

* Added the `ELECTRON_DEBUG_DRAGGABLE_REGIONS` environment variable, which visualizes and logs draggable regions in unpackaged apps to help debug custom title bars. [#53627](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53627) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53633), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53626))</sup>
## Fixes

* File System Access permission requests and the `file-system-access-restricted` event are scoped to the requesting document, grants are reset when the origin's last page closes, and write access works in in-memory sessions. [#53691](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53691) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53695), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53694), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53690))</sup>
* Fixed Ctrl+Y not yanking text killed with Ctrl+K in text fields on macOS. [#53714](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53714) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53715))</sup>
* Fixed `Tray` icons not appearing when running inside Flatpak or Snap sandboxes on Linux. [#53653](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53653) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53654))</sup>
* Fixed `app.getGPUInfo('complete')` stalling the GPU process for several seconds on some Windows systems. [#53644](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53644) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53645))</sup>
* Fixed `session.setPermissionCheckHandler` receiving the top-level origin and a null `webContents` for `hid` and `usb` checks made from a subframe. [#53688](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53688) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53736), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53689), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53679))</sup>
* Fixed `webContents.on()`, `removeListener()` and `removeAllListeners()` throwing "Object has been destroyed" for `console-message` listeners after the WebContents was destroyed. [#53494](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53494) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53497), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53496), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53495))</sup>
* Fixed a crash on Linux when `process.env` was written while another thread was reading the environment, and a memory leak when a worker thread exits. [#53509](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53509) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53511), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53510), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53508))</sup>
* Fixed a possible crash on Windows when a file dialog was shown for a window that was being closed at the same time. [#53583](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53583) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53585), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53584), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53586))</sup>
* Fixed a renderer crash when the main process sent IPC to, or a page navigated, a same-process `window.open()` child whose `contextIsolation` differed from its opener's. [#53539](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53539) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53541), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53540), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53538))</sup>
* Fixed a spurious `node_init` error being logged when creating a `ShadowRealm` with Node.js integration enabled. [#53579](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53579) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53578))</sup>
* Fixed crashes in `setDisplayMediaRequestHandler` when the granted frame had been destroyed or another tab was granted by id. [#53672](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53672) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53674), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53671), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53673))</sup>
* Fixed several non-functional DevTools integrations: the Security panel's "View certificate" button, Ctrl+wheel zooming inside DevTools, and DevTools keyboard shortcuts (e.g. F8) while the inspected page has focus. [#53630](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53630) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53631), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53471))</sup>
* Fixed window state not being persisted when a window entered or left fullscreen, or was maximized or unmaximized, without also being moved or resized. [#53576](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53576) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53577))</sup>
* Internal `<webview>`, `window.close()` and `executeJavaScript` reply IPCs are validated against the sending frame. [#53723](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53723) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53727), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53726), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53724))</sup>
* `<webview>` without `allowpopups` also blocks links opened into a new window by modifier-click, and such windows navigate as the clicking document rather than as a browser-initiated load. [#53721](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53721) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53719), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53718), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53717))</sup>
* `getUserMedia` with `chromeMediaSource: 'desktop'` no longer accepts WebContents source ids; use `chromeMediaSource: 'tab'` with `webContents.getMediaSourceId()` or `setDisplayMediaRequestHandler` to capture a WebContents. [#53709](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53709) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53710), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53707), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53708))</sup>
* `nodeIntegrationInWorker` now applies only to workers created by frames that themselves have Node integration; enable `nodeIntegrationInSubFrames` to keep Node in workers created by subframes. [#53711](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53711) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53713), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53712), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53706))</sup>
* `openExternal` permission requests started by a frame that has since gone away are attributed to that frame's origin rather than to the navigating page. [#53699](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53699) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53697), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53698), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53696))</sup>
* `pointerLock` and `keyboardLock` permission requests now report the requesting frame, and `execCommand('paste')` requires user activation in the frame that calls it. [#53693](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53693) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53702), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53701), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53692))</sup>
## Other Changes

* Fixed the app becoming unresponsive when a page has a very large number of `app-region` draggable elements. [#53597](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53597) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53632), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53596))</sup>
* Updated Chromium to 152.0.7977.78. [#53523](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53523)

name: electron v44.4.0
body:
# Release Notes for v44.4.0

## Features

* Added `initiatorOrigin` to webRequest and protocol handler requests, `DownloadItem.getInitiatorOrigin()`, and a trailing `frame` argument to the `will-download` and `preconnect` session events. [#53703](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53703) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53704), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53700))</sup>

## Fixes

* Added validation to `protocol.registerSchemesAsPrivileged()` to reject protocol names that do not conform to RFC 3986 URI scheme grammar. [#53743](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53743) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53742))</sup>
* Fixed a crash when a webContents navigated to the Chrome Web Store and the page invoked the unsupported `chrome.webstorePrivate` API. [#53776](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53776) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53775))</sup>
* Fixed a main-process crash when an app called `loadURL()` again right after a load failed because the renderer process exited before the page committed. [#53943](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53943) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53944), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53942))</sup>
* Fixed a memory leak on Windows when `app.getPreferredSystemLanguages()` was called. [#53868](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53868) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53867), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53869))</sup>
* Fixed a potential UAF in `app.getPreferredSystemLanguages()` on Windows. [#53865](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53865) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53866), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53864))</sup>
* Fixed a renderer crash that could occur when printing from an iframe. [#53762](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53762) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53761), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53763))</sup>
* Fixed a renderer crash when an iframe was removed right after loading with `nodeIntegrationInSubFrames` enabled and `sandbox` disabled, e.g. on pages that embed Meta Pixel. [#53885](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53885) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53886), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53884), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53883))</sup>
* Fixed a Windows renderer crash when no default locale could be determined. [#53947](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53947)
* Fixed an issue where the browser-side check that blocks drag and drop between cross-site frames of the same page was disabled. [#53749](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53749) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53750), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53748))</sup>
* Fixed helper executables on macOS starting a second app instance when launched without a process type, for example through `child_process.fork()` with the `runAsNode` fuse disabled; `fork()` now throws in that configuration. [#53840](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53840) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53839))</sup>
* Fixed V8 code caching for https scripts loaded by `file://` and custom-scheme pages. [#53745](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53745) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53746))</sup>
* Fixed `webContents` emitting `unresponsive` right after the system wakes from sleep on Windows, and emitting `responsive` when a hung window was hidden rather than when it recovered. [#53764](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53764) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53760))</sup>
* Fixed `webContents.capturePage()` on offscreen windows returning an image resampled to the display's scale factor instead of rendered at the window's `offscreen.deviceScaleFactor`. [#53816](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53816) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53818), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53817))</sup>
* Fixed Window Controls Overlay CSS environment variables and `navigator.windowControlsOverlay` not being populated for `WebContentsView`s in a `BaseWindow`. [#53812](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53812) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53811))</sup>

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream ANGLE, Chromium, libyuv, PDFium and V8. [#53769](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53769)
* Updated Node.js to v24.21.0. [#53779](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53779)

name: electron v44.4.1
body:
# Release Notes for v44.4.1

## Fixes

* Fixed default protocol client APIs falsely returning `true` on Windows. [#53959](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53959) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53960), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53958))</sup>
* Fixed several object lifetime issues in `Debugger`, `Menu`, `Tray`, `Notification`, `globalShortcut`, `utilityProcess`, `ServiceWorkerMain`, `WebFrameMain`, `webFrame`, `sharedTexture`, `systemPreferences`, `netLog`, `MessagePortMain`, `net.request` and `shell.openPath()`. [#53968](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53968) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53805))</sup>

name: electron v44.4.2
body:

* Fixed a potential UAF when a `select-usb-device` handler destroys the requesting `webContents`. [#54009](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54009) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54007), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54008))</sup>

name: electron v44.4.3
body:
# Release Notes for v44.4.3

## Fixes

* Fixed `net.fetch()` / `net.request()` spending seconds of main-process time buffering large streamed request bodies. [#54061](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54061) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54062))</sup>

## Performance Improvements

* Improved the performance of `fs` operations and `require()` on files inside asar archives. [#54051](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54051) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/53951))</sup>

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream Chromium, PDFium, Skia and V8. [#54081](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54081)

name: electron v44.7.0
body:
# Release Notes for v44.7.0

## Features

* The macOS `autoUpdater` now streams update downloads to disk, resumes an interrupted download on the next check instead of starting over, and applies a binary delta when the update feed offers one for the running version. [#54204](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54204)

## Fixes

* Fixed an uncatchable TypeError in `net.fetch` when receiving response headers with non-ASCII characters, and preserved multiple Set-Cookie headers. [#54672](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54672)

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream ANGLE, Chromium, Dawn, fontconfig, Skia, V8 and WebRTC. [#54666](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54666)
* Backported fixes from upstream ANGLE, Chromium, Skia, V8 and WebRTC. [#54657](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54657)

name: electron v44.7.1
body:
# Release Notes for v44.7.1

## Fixes

* Fixed a crash when starting without an available display server on Linux. [#54794](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54794) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54781))</sup>
* Fixed a Linux crash creating a window with a menu bar when GTK failed to load. [#54859](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54859) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54846))</sup>
* Fixed a `WebContentsView` that was removed with `removeChildView()` and re-added with `addChildView()` staying hidden behind its sibling views on Linux. [#54798](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54798)
* Fixed asar archives in non-ASCII folders failing to load on Linux. [#54849](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54849) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54848))</sup>
* Fixed renderer crashes during garbage collection inside ShadowRealms. [#54865](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54865) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54864))</sup>

## Other Changes

* Refactored mouse forwarding on Windows to fix `setIgnoreMouseEvents(true, { forward: true })` related issues. [#54802](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54802) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54803))</sup>
* Updated Chromium to 152.0.7977.149. [#54085](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54085)

name: electron v44.7.2
body:
# Release Notes for v44.7.2

## Fixes

* Fixed an issue where clicks posted to a background app were dropped on macOS. [#54819](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54819) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54818))</sup>
* Fixed interrupted macOS updates leaving a broken app behind. [#54844](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54844) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54843))</sup>

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream ANGLE, Chromium, PDFium and V8. [#54898](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54898)

## Documentation

 * Documentation changes: [#54880](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54880)

name: electron v44.8.0
body:
# Release Notes for v44.8.0

## Features

* Added support for `Notification` action buttons on Linux. [#54890](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54890) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54889))</sup>

## Fixes

* Fixed mouse cursor missing over native dialogs in certain scenarios on Windows. [#54987](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54987)
* Fixed `net.fetch` and `session.fetch` failing permanently with `net::ERR_FAILED` after the Network Service process restarts. [#54909](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54909) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54925), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54908), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54910))</sup>
* Fixed `utilityProcess` dropping messages posted with `process.parentPort.postMessage()` right before the process exits. [#54960](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54960) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55000), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54962), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54956))</sup>
* Fixed `win.isFullScreen()` being stale in fullscreen events on Windows. [#55009](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55009) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55008))</sup>

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream Chromium and V8. [#55034](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55034)
* Updated Chromium to 152.0.7977.167. [#54928](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54928)
* Updated Node.js to v24.22.0. [#55004](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55004)

name: electron v44.9.0
body:
# Release Notes for v44.9.0

## Features

* Added app shims on macOS to show windows under another app's Dock icon. [#55073](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55073) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55072))</sup>

## Fixes

* Fixed link-opened windows not using the opener's session and `webPreferences`. [#55048](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55048) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55050), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55049), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55051))</sup>
* Fixed `setCertificateVerifyProc` occasionally not being applied to a request issued concurrently with the first request to a host. [#55046](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55046) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55054), [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55047), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55045))</sup>
